title: Kissed Garlicky Irish Broccoli Skillet
description: A garlicky and gooey Irish dish featuring broccoli and bonito flakes, perfect for a brunch mood, served on a cedar plank. This paleo-friendly recipe is a delicious and healthy option for any meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and black pepper.
Pour the eggs over the broccoli and garlic in the skillet.
Sprinkle the bonito flakes over the top of the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Serve the kissed garlicky Irish broccoli skillet on a cedar plank.
